model_annotation: This plot illustrates the loss values over a range of iterations for different models. The x-axis represents the number of iterations on a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 140,000, with tick labels at regular intervals of 20,000. The y-axis represents the loss on a linear scale, ranging from 2.4 to 3.4, with tick labels at intervals of 0.1. There are five lines in the plot: the purple line represents "Vanilla" with no markers and a solid line style, starting at approximately 3.35 and decreasing to around 2.55; the blue line represents "StrmLLM (n=64)" with no markers and a solid line style, starting at approximately 3.35 and decreasing to around 2.55; the orange line represents "SepLLM (n=64, H)" with no markers and a solid line style, starting at approximately 3.25 and decreasing to around 2.5; the red line represents "SepLLM (n=64, H/T)" with no markers and a solid line style, starting at approximately 3.25 and decreasing to around 2.5; and the dark blue line represents "SepLLM (n=128)" with no markers and a solid line style, starting at approximately 3.25 and decreasing to around 2.5; all lines exhibit a sharp decline in loss in the early iterations, followed by a gradual decrease.
